title: 第两千零六十五章 这合理吗第两千零六十四章 局势反转
content_zh:
第两千零六十五章：这合理吗？
这话一出，周围顿时一片倒吸凉气的声音。
天门七重碾压天门巅峰，这已经够恐怖了。
而足以击败天王境，这显然已经是一个全新的概念了。
“完了完了完了……”回过神，一个之前嘲讽过云琪的弟子脸色惨白：“刚刚我还在嘲讽师姐，要是师姐之后找我麻烦……我还有活路吗？”
他旁边的人啐了一口：“你就是活该，叫你狗眼看人低！能引动万仙朝拜异象的人，能是寻常人吗？”
“没错！人家之前那是不想认真打，你们非得逼人家露真功夫，现在傻眼了吧？”
之前出言嘲讽的那几个弟子全都缩着脖子，恨不得把脑袋埋进地里。
擂台上。
赵无极半跪在地上，大口大口地喘着粗气。鲜血从他的额头淌下来，滴落在碎裂的石板上，他的眼神中满是不可置信与屈辱。
云琪提着银霜剑，一步步靠近。
最终在赵无极面前三步处停下。
“我还记得，师兄之前在我剑峰，也是让我这般姿态跪在地上的吧。”
“你……”
赵无极咬紧了牙关，撑在地面上的双手青筋暴起，他想要站起来。
可迎接他的，是一道银白的剑光。
“啪！”
银霜剑的剑背重重拍在他的肩膀上，赵无极闷哼一声，整个人又被拍得趴了下去，脸都贴在了石板上。
“师兄。”云琪居高临下地看着他：“比试还没结束呢，你不认输，怕是不能起来。”
“你……你居然敢羞辱我！”

赵无极的声音几乎是从牙缝里挤出来的，他的双眼已经因为愤怒而布满了血丝。
“羞辱？”
云琪歪了歪头，像是在认真思考这个词的含义。
片刻后，她轻轻笑了一声。
“那你之前羞辱我和银宝师弟的时候呢？天道好轮回，你既然做了这种事，就应该会想到这一日。”
赵无极趴在地上，整个身体都在发抖。
那是难以形容的愤怒和不甘，是被一直瞧不起的人踩在脚下所带来的极致耻辱。
“啊，这是你逼我的！”
伴随着一声犹如野兽般的嘶吼，赵无极体内猛然爆发出一股极为恐怖的气息。
“不好！”陈长老脸色大变：“这……这股气息是……”
放眼望去，只见赵无极的双眼在刹那间变成了诡异的漆黑色，眼眶中再无一丝眼白。
皮肤表面也浮现出一道道暗红色的纹路，像是某种古老而邪恶的咒印。
下一刻，一股狂暴到近乎失控的灵力波动从他体内迸发出来。
在这股力量下，就连擂台上的禁制光幕都被冲得剧烈摇晃。
“无极居然练成了这门秘法？”白胡子长老失声喃喃。
“碎星禁术！”陈长老的脸色难看得像锅底：“这是碎星拳中记载的禁忌法门，以透支自己为代价，在短时间内获得超越自身极限的力量！”
“胡闹！”另一个长老一拍扶手：“这是比试，又不是生死搏杀！”
台下，有见识广的弟子也认出了这一招，脸色瞬间变得煞白。
content_en:
Chapter 2065: Is this reasonable?
As soon as these words came out, there was a sudden gasp of air all around.
The seventh level of Tianmen crushed the peak of Tianmen, which was terrifying enough.
And being able to defeat the Heavenly King Realm is obviously a completely new concept.
"It's over, it's over..." When he came back to his senses, a disciple who had mocked Yun Qi before turned pale: "I was still mocking Senior Sister just now. If Senior Sister comes to trouble me in the future... Do I still have a way to survive?"
The person next to him spat: "You deserve to be called a dog and look down on others! Can a person who can inspire thousands of immortals to worship the vision be an ordinary person?"
"That's right! I didn't want to fight seriously before, but you had to force me to show my true skills. Are you dumbfounded now?"
The disciples who had taunted him before all shrank their necks and wished they could bury their heads in the ground.
In the arena.
Zhao Wuji was half kneeling on the ground, breathing heavily. Blood dripped from his forehead and dripped onto the broken stone slab. His eyes were full of disbelief and humiliation.
Yun Qi held the Silver Frost Sword and approached step by step.
Finally, he stopped three steps in front of Zhao Wuji.
"I still remember that my senior brother made me kneel on the ground in this posture before in my Sword Peak."
"You..."
Zhao Wuji gritted his teeth, and the veins in his hands that were resting on the ground popped out as he tried to stand up.
But what greeted him was a silver sword light.
"Crack!"
The back of the Silver Frost Sword slapped him hard on the shoulder. Zhao Wuji grunted, and he fell down again from the slap, with his face pressed against the stone slab.
"Senior brother." Yun Qi looked at him condescendingly: "The competition is not over yet. If you don't admit defeat, I'm afraid you won't be able to get up."
"You...how dare you humiliate me!"
Zhao Wuji's voice was almost squeezed out from between his teeth, and his eyes were already bloodshot with anger.
"Humiliation?"
Yun Qi tilted her head, as if she was seriously thinking about the meaning of this word.
After a moment, she laughed softly.
"What about when you humiliated Junior Brother Yinbao and me before? Heaven's way is reincarnation. Since you have done such a thing, you should think of this day."
Zhao Wuji lay on the ground, his whole body trembling.
It was indescribable anger and unwillingness, and the ultimate humiliation brought about by being stepped on by someone who had always looked down upon him.
"Ah, you forced me to do this!"
Along with a beast-like roar, an extremely terrifying aura suddenly erupted from Zhao Wuji's body.
"Not good!" Elder Chen's expression changed drastically: "This... this breath is..."
Looking around, I saw that Zhao Wuji's eyes turned into a strange pitch black in an instant, and there was no trace of white in the eye sockets.
Dark red lines also appeared on the surface of the skin, like some kind of ancient and evil curse mark.
The next moment, a wave of spiritual power that was so violent that it was almost out of control burst out from his body.
Under this force, even the forbidden light curtain on the arena was shaken violently.
"Wuji actually mastered this secret technique?" Elder Whitebeard murmured.
"Broken Star Forbidden Technique!" Elder Chen's face was as ugly as the bottom of a pot: "This is a forbidden method recorded in the Broken Star Fist. At the expense of overstretching yourself, you can gain power beyond your own limits in a short period of time!"
"Nonsense!" Another elder slapped the armrest: "This is a competition, not a life and death fight!"
In the audience, the knowledgeable disciples also recognized this move, and their faces instantly turned pale.
